primary_endpoint: Change in liver fat measured by MRI-PDFF from baseline to 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: MRI-PDFF values reported as 15.0 vs 18.5 and 11.6 vs 16.4 for ezetimibe and placebo, respectively; no statistical comparison was reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 1/25 with ezetimibe and 0/25 with placebo; no deaths in either group.
